payload.question: Should we raise cold brew prices again?

verdict.label: DON'T
verdict.call: Do not raise cold brew again. Lower to $4 as a one-week test; $5 already cut volume from about 35 to about 20 daily and triggered repeated too-much complaints.

next_steps.action: Stop any further cold brew price increase; confirm $4 test start.
Run $4 for one week, track daily cold brew volume and revenue.
Review test volume, complaints, and cost per cup before deciding.

parsed.title: 10-Minute Lesson: Test Cold Brew Price With Your Own Files
parsed.why: Teaches you to test price decisions with your own sales and reviews, not gut feel, using cited evidence before changing prices again.
steps: 2 min: Upload sales.csv and price_list.md; ask AI to compare cold brew volume before/after $5 change [price_list.md:6][sales.csv:30]
3 min: Add reviews.csv; ask AI to list repeated complaints with line citations, ignoring one-off praise [reviews.csv:3]
3 min: Ask AI for verdict and one-week test plan; check every cited number against files [sales.csv:45]
2 min: Decide, record test dates, track daily volume and revenue before any new increase [price_list.md:6]
parsed.prompt_to_copy: Using only my files [SALES_FILE], [PRICE_LIST], and [REVIEWS], decide whether to raise [PRODUCT] price again. Compare volume and revenue before/after [PRICE_CHANGE_DATE]. List repeated complaints with file line citations. Give verdict, risks, and a one-week test with daily metrics to track. Do not use outside data.
parsed.try_next: Next: Run $4 test for one week, then review volume, revenue, and complaints [price_list.md:6]
